name: Projects
description: Projects that run for weeks, on a Gantt timeline: phases with a start, an end and who does each one. Drag a bar to move or resize it, or drag a project to move its whole plan. Someone booked on two phases at once is flagged. Each project keeps its drawings, quotes and site photos in one place. For contractors, installers, renovation teams and agencies. Like Monday.com's timeline, Microsoft Project or TeamGantt.

deploy.subtitle: Plan projects on a timeline and keep each one's files in one place, on your own database
